item.text:
The audit now documents eight reproduced findings in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F8: empty-tail transaction-log recovery overstates the last durable zxid**. [FileTxnLog.getLastLoggedZxid](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/persistence/FileTxnLog.java:365) initializes its result from the newest log filename. When that file is empty, the iterator deletes it but the method still returns its filename-derived zxid. The repro writes zxid 1 and 2, empties the newest log, and observes:

```
reported last logged zxid: 2
AssertionError: empty tail made getLastLoggedZxid report 2 instead of 1
```

This is election-relevant because `QuorumPeer` uses `getLastLoggedZxid()` when constructing its initial vote. Reproduction: [LastLoggedEmptyRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/last_logged_empty/LastLoggedEmptyRepro.java).

The other seven findings remain documented: snapshot-fallback state leakage, zero snapshot-size division, non-terminating oracle revalidation, 3+ voter oracle election bypass, digest/lastZxid snapshot incompatibility, data retention on `TRUNC(0)`, and runtime-exception fallback failure. All reproduction outputs are preserved under `repro/`; the captured source was not modified.
